fusions.name: Tail Lash
fusions.desc: Whips your weight around to hit a target up to 4 tiles away, which deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Awaited Crunch
fusions.desc: A bite that strikes only a target at or below 25% health. It deals 24 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Sunned Hide
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Warm-Blooded Hours
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage.
